facts.text: The resort's address is 295 Three Mile Harbor Hog Creek Rd, East Hampton, NY 11937.
facts.excerpt: 295 Three Mile Harbor Hog Creek Rd, East Hampton, NY 11937

facts.text: EHP Resort & Marina is a nine-acre waterfront resort, marina and wedding destination inspired by a modern Mediterranean ethos.
facts.excerpt: EHP Resort & Marina is a striking nine-acre waterfront resort, marina, and wedding destination inspired by a modern Mediterranean ethos.

facts.text: The resort offers private cottage accommodations.
facts.excerpt: private cottage accommodations, spectacular open-air dining, curated activities, luxury amenities

facts.text: The resort was named one of 'The Best Hotels in the Hamptons' by Vogue.
facts.excerpt: Named one of “The Best Hotels in the Hamptons” by Vogue

facts.text: The marina overlooks Three Mile Harbor and lets guests traveling by yacht dock and dine.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking Three Mile Harbor, EHP’s impressive marina will provides ultimate accessibility for those traveling to EHP by yacht, enabling the yachting community to dock and dine.

facts.text: The restaurant Si Si is inspired by coastal Mediterranean dining, with flavors of Italy, Greece, Spain, Morocco and beyond.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by coastal Mediterranean dining experiences, Si Si, or “yes yes,” in both Italian and Spanish, immerses you in the sun-kissed flavors of Italy, Greece, Spain, Morocco and beyond.

facts.text: Si Si is closed for a la carte dining for the 2026 season.
facts.excerpt: Sí Sí is closed for à la carte dining for the 2026 season - see you next year!

facts.text: Resort guests can design their own boat charter or choose from the captain's preferred experiences.
facts.excerpt: Resort guests can design their own charter or choose from a variety of the captain's preferred experiences.

facts.text: Charters can stop for a swim at a secluded beach and cruise by the local lighthouses of Long Island's East End.
facts.excerpt: Stop for a swim at a secluded beach, cruise by the local lighthouses, and enjoy the beauty of Long Island's East End.

facts.text: South Fork charter recommendations include Sag Harbor, Montauk and seal-watching on the coast of the East End.
facts.excerpt: South Fork: Sag Harbor, Montauk, Seal-watching on the coast of the East End

facts.text: The property was formerly East Hampton Point.
facts.excerpt: While it retains the classic Hamptons charm of the former East Hampton Point, the redesign has infused it with a fresh, contemporary spirit.

facts.text: The resort was transformed in recent years and reimagined with a modern Mediterranean aesthetic.
facts.excerpt: EHP Resort & Marina underwent a significant transformation in recent years, and was reimagined with a modern Mediterranean aesthetic.

facts.text: Rooms have Assouline travel books, Acqua di Parma bath products, Frette linens and Vitruvi diffusers.
facts.excerpt: Assouline travel tomes, Acqua di Parma bath products, Frette linens, and Vitruvi diffusers signal the resort’s quiet attention to detail.

facts.text: The one- and two-bedroom cottages have fully equipped kitchens and generous living spaces.
facts.excerpt: Families gravitate toward the one- and two-bedroom cottages, conveniently containing fully-equipped kitchens and generous living spaces

facts.text: The Magari Harbor House suites have Carrara marble bathrooms and rooftop decks.
facts.excerpt: couples often book the Magari Harbor House suites, prized for their Carrara marble bathrooms, rooftop decks, and design-forward interiors

facts.text: Buongiorno is a cafe inside a curated marina boutique.
facts.excerpt: head to Buongiorno, a café nestled within a curated marina boutique

facts.text: East Hampton Village, with its boutiques and restaurants, is within 15 minutes by car.
facts.excerpt: the allure of East Hampton Village, with its chic boutiques and acclaimed restaurants, is accessible within 15 minutes by car.

facts.text: The resort has a pool, a tennis court and plenty of outdoor space for children.
facts.excerpt: EHP caters to families well, with spacious accommodations, a beautiful pool, a tennis court, and plenty of outdoor space for kids to run around.

facts.text: The resort can arrange babysitting services.
facts.excerpt: The resort can also arrange for babysitting services, allowing parents to enjoy a romantic dinner.

facts.text: The bright blue tennis courts have rackets and balls available for adults and children.
facts.excerpt: head to the bright blue courts for a spot of tennis—they have rackets and balls available for adults and children.

facts.text: The concierge can book dinner reservations and arrange boat charters.
facts.excerpt: The concierge can assist with everything from booking dinner reservations to arranging boat charters.

facts.text: The resort meets ADA standards, with accessible rooms and facilities throughout the property.
facts.excerpt: EHP meets ADA standards, with accessible rooms and facilities throughout the property.

facts.text: The resort sits on the edge of Three Mile Harbor and centers around its marina.
facts.excerpt: Nestled on the tranquil edge of Three Mile Harbor, EHP offers the kind of low-key luxury that’s increasingly rare in the Hamptons. The resort centers around the marina

facts.text: The space that formerly housed Sunset Harbor will become Wayan & Made, from Cedric and Ochi Vongerichten.
facts.excerpt: This season, the space that formerly housed Sunset Harbor will transform into Wayan & Madé, Cedric and Ochi Vongerichten's popular Indonesian-French restaurants

facts.text: Si Si reservations can be scarce over the summer months, so booking ahead is advised.
facts.excerpt: Be sure to book Sí Sí in advance, as reservations can be scarce over the summer months.

facts.text: Sustainability commitments include locally sourced ingredients and aligning with the Town of East Hampton's environmental initiatives.
facts.excerpt: EHP's commitments to sustainability include using locally-sourced ingredients for its restaurants and aligning with the Town of East Hampton's environmental initiatives.

facts.text: The Pollock-Krasner House, Sag Harbor and the boutiques of Newton Lane are within reach of the resort.
facts.excerpt: the Pollock-Krasner House offers an intimate glimpse into the region’s artistic history, while the understated charms of Sag Harbor and the boutiques of Newton Lane are also conveniently accessible.

facts.text: Accommodations combine modern minimalism with subtle Mediterranean touches and a calming palette.
facts.excerpt: Think modern minimalism infused with subtle Mediterranean touches, a calming palette, and an emphasis on elevated comfort.
